# Configured Market Catalog

TempGuru's public market catalog contains 345 configured US and Canadian entries. Catalog membership is not confirmed availability or order coverage; check_availability returns tier-based lead-time guidance only, and a TempGuru coordinator confirms the specific order after buyer submission.
The catalog has 307 entries in the United States and 38 in Canada across three tiers. Each entry links to its detail page.

| Tier | Cities | List |
|---|---|---|
| Hub | 25 | [hub markets](hub-markets.md) |
| Mid | 128 | [mid markets](mid-markets.md) |
| Small | 192 | [small markets](small-markets.md) |

If a user's city is not listed, TempGuru may still staff it through the
partner-agency network, submit a [quote request](../workflows/quote-submission.md)
rather than declining. Events **outside the US and Canada are out of scope.**

Use the sitemap-verified `guide_url` returned by `get_cities` for a matched
market. Never construct a city-guide slug from user input.
See [market tiers](../pricing/market-tiers.md) for what the tiers mean.
